feedback: Say what the caller reported at the top: electrical burning smell, smoke thickening by the copy room, no flames, alarm not sounding. Your message never says this, so the crew doesn't know how serious it is.

Two numbers aren't in the building record: ~1994 people above (the record has only a ~2441 note for above floor 30) and the wind from E at 10 mph. Don't send figures you can't back up. Also, the standpipe/FDC "not known" line has nothing behind it in the data.

You left out the freight elevator on record, and you didn't name CME Group as the tenant on floor 36. You also gave no exits or pull stations, which this call type needs first. Hydrant distances don't make up for that.
